duty.cafe: clock in at the serving window and make cups; they lack initiative.
duty.stand: step behind Fig Jr.’s stand and pour lemonade.

wage: the week’s wage is {coins}; payday is Monday, {days} days away.
done: the week’s work is done; the remaining days are yours to misplace.

nudge.condo: Spinner’s letter asks you to come to the arcade; the floor is not self-sweeping.
nudge.store: Pip’s letter asks you to come to the store; the crate remains deeply patient.
nudge.post: Stamp wrote asking if you’re coming in; the counter pile is waiting.
nudge.cafe: Bean’s letter asks you to come and pour; the counter is quiet without you.
nudge.stand: Fig Jr. has written about low staffing; the stand needs a shift from you.

fired.condo: Spinner has let you go; ask again and you start from the first rank.
fired.store: Pip has let you go; ask again and you start from the first rank.
fired.post: Stamp let you go after empty weeks; ask again and you start at the first rank.
fired.cafe: Bean has let you go; ask again and you start from the first cup.
fired.stand: Fig Jr. has let you go; reapply and you start again at entry level.

cafeDone: tips gather on the tray as you pour; paid when you step away.
standDone: pour lemonade; tray tips are paid when you step away.
payslip: go home and open the payslip waiting in your letterbox; it has news.

call.sweep: Spinner calls: litter on the arcade floor, open until midnight.
call.fix: Spinner calls: a cabinet has gone dark, open until midnight.
call.restock: Pip calls: a delivery waits to be shelved, open until midnight.
call.serve: Pip calls: customers are waiting at the till, open until midnight.
call.deliver: Pip calls: a parcel waits at the store to be delivered, open until midnight.

answered: every call today is answered; nothing more is wanted until tomorrow.
